opportunity.title: Survey-Based Research Platform and Platform Management Tool (RFI)
opportunity.description: The VA Acquisition Academy needs a Software as a Service survey-based research platform and platform management tool to securely collect responses to a competency survey it is piloting for acquisition human capital planning. Required: software subscriptions, maintenance and support. Period of performance is a 12-month base plus four 12-month options. Respondents provide a rough order of magnitude price against the salient characteristics by email by Oct 20, 2026.

rationale.point: The RFI is for a SaaS survey-based research platform and platform management tool (Claim #1), which aligns with the company's web and data platform experience, though the specific survey competency focus (Claim #2) is new.
Company holds SBA certification and NAICS 541519 matches; places of performance include VA and REMOTE, satisfying eligibility.

Past performance includes three web/data platform projects under $500K each for state/local agencies, but no prior VA, DoD, or HHS prime contracts, indicating limited federal past performance for this agency.
Team of six engineers with no facility clearance and no SOC 2 report may pose security/compliance risks for a platform that must securely collect survey responses (Claim #2).

risks: No prior VA prime contracts reduces credibility for a VA-specific opportunity.
Absence of SOC 2 report may not meet VA security requirements for a SaaS platform handling survey data.
Median award size for VA NAICS 541519 is ~$99M, far exceeding company's historical project size (<$500K), suggesting potential future solicitation may be too large.
Set-aside is NONE, meaning full-and-open competition against larger firms.
nextSteps: Respond to the Sources Sought RFI to express interest and capability, highlighting relevant web/platform projects.
Request clarification on expected contract vehicle, size, and security requirements (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC 2).
Assess teaming options with firms holding VA past performance and security certifications.
Begin SOC 2 Type II audit preparation to strengthen future proposal.
Monitor for follow-on solicitation and evaluate bid/no-bid at that time with full requirements.
